title: TimeSCCAN
description: A tool for sparse statistical analysis on connectivity within a subject.

number_consecutive_labels.description: Number of consecutive labels in data.
number_consecutive_labels.title: Number of Consecutive Labels

minimum_region_size.description: Minimum size of a region: regions below this size are given a 0.0 connectivity value.
minimum_region_size.title: Minimum Region Size

sparsity.description: Sparsity - a float from (0,1] indicating what fraction of the data to use.
sparsity.title: Sparsity

n_eigenvectors.description: Number of permutations to use in scca.
n_eigenvectors.title: Number of Eigenvectors

l1.description: Use l1 ( > 0 ) or l0 ( < 0 ) penalty, also sets gradient step size e.g. -l 0.5 ( L1 ) , -l -0.5 (L0) will set 0.5 grad descent step for either penalty.
l1.title: L1 Penalty

ridge_cca.description: Number of permutations to use in scca.
ridge_cca.title: Ridge CCA

partial_scca_option.description: Choices for partial SCCA: PQ, PminusRQ, PQminusR, PminusRQminusR.
partial_scca_option.title: Partial SCCA Option

timeseriesimage_to_matrix.description: Takes a timeseries (4D) image and converts it to a 2D matrix csv format as output. If the mask has multiple labels (more than one), then the average time series in each label will be computed and put in the csv.
timeseriesimage_to_matrix.title: Timeseries Image to Matrix

labelsimage_to_matrix.description: Takes a labeled (3D) image and converts it to a 2D matrix csv format as output.
labelsimage_to_matrix.title: Labels Image to Matrix
